collect_enabled.description: Enable or disable data collection from PostgreSQL servers.

data_dir.description: Directory where raw collected data will be stored (must exist and be writable).

report_dir.description: Directory where HTML reports will be generated.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain collected data (0 = keep forever).

connstr.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the primary database (or comma-separated list for multiple DBs).

collection_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between consecutive data collection samples.

summary_hours.description: Number of hours of data to aggregate for summary reports (e.g., daily summaries). Set to 0 to disable.

detailed_enabled.description: Collect detailed runtime statistics (e.g., pg_stat_activity, pg_stat_replication).

locks_enabled.description: Enable collection of lock waits and blocking information.

wal_enabled.description: Enable collection of WAL (write-ahead log) activity metrics.

replication_enabled.description: Enable collection of streaming replication lag and status.

io_enabled.description: Enable collection of I/O statistics (requires PostgreSQL 9.2+).

query_text_enabled.description: Collect full SQL query text (requires pg_stat_statements extension).

servers.description: List of additional PostgreSQL servers to monitor (for distributed environments).

interval.description: Override collection interval for this server (seconds). If omitted, uses global value.

summary_hours.description: Override summary aggregation window for this server (hours). If omitted, uses global value.

tags.description: Optional labels/tags to group/filter this server in reports (e.g., ['prod','shard-2']).

log_file.description: Path to log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

mail_enabled.description: Enable email notifications for alerts (e.g., long-running queries, lock waits).

mail_to.description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses.

mail_smtp.description: SMTP server hostname or IP for sending emails.

http_enabled.description: Enable built-in HTTP server to serve HTML reports.

http_host.description: Interface to bind HTTP server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

http_auth_enabled.description: Enable basic HTTP authentication for web UI access.

http_base_url.description: Base URL path (useful for reverse proxy setups like nginx with /pgcluu/ location).

http_gzip_enabled.description: Enable gzip compression for HTTP responses (reduces bandwidth for large reports).

http_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

http_ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format).

timezone.description: Timezone for timestamps in generated reports (IANA timezone name).

auto_report_enabled.description: Automatically generate HTML reports after data collection completes.

workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent workers for data collection (useful for multi-server setups).

bloat_enabled.description: Estimate and collect table bloat (dead tuple) statistics.

index_bloat_enabled.description: Estimate and collect index bloat statistics (requires PostgreSQL 9.4+).

extensions_enabled.description: Collect usage and version info for installed extensions.

users_enabled.description: Collect user activity, login counts, and session stats.

size_enabled.description: Track database, table, and index sizes over time.
